pre_mortem.premise: It is 2027-09-06, twelve months after this dive, and the WATCH call was wrong.
reasons: The market's extrapolation proved right rather than the dive's caution: FY2026 organic growth held at or above the raised 10-11% guided floor through year-end, the non-SmartDose-3.5 Delivery Devices business kept compounding at 'double digits' or better into FY2027, and a third and fourth consecutive guidance raise closed the gap between the market's 32.96% five-year FCF-CAGR ask and this dive's own 10.67% base case faster than the reverse-DCF math implied was likely. In hindsight the 82%-buy-rating sell-side consensus this dive's crowdedness section flagged as a tension, rather than a contradiction, would have been the better read of the evidence, and staying at WATCH through the October 2026 and subsequent quarters meant missing a continuation of a still-early re-rating.

The bear case realized and the WATCH should have named a hard ceiling instead of leaving no_entry_above null: FY2026 organic growth printed at or below the 10% floor (watch_triggers[0]), the non-SmartDose device business decelerated below 'double digits' (watch_triggers[1]), and deferred income kept falling past $45.7M (watch_triggers[2]), confirming that Q1-Q2 2026's reacceleration was a comp-driven spike (partly the now-divested SmartDose 3.5mL line, partly a GLP-1 demand pull-forward) rather than a durable structural shift, at which point the stock, still carrying a rich forward multiple, corrected sharply from $342.08 toward or through this dive's own would-buy zone within the 90-day COMPOUNDER clock, and this dive's own entry-basis-stress finding (that the zone is a base-case-fair floor, not a bear-survived one) meant the drawn zone still overpaid relative to the bear case that actually played out.

An idiosyncratic, leadership-driven event overtook the GLP-1 thesis this dive is built around: the new CEO (Michel Lagarde, five days into the role at this dive's as_of date) used the balance-sheet strength this dive's earnings-quality section already documents (net cash, Piotroski 8/9, $454M of buybacks already executed in H1 2026) for a large acquisition or further portfolio reshaping that changed West's growth algorithm, margin mix, or capital-allocation story in a direction this dive's GLP-1-device-platform framework never modeled, making the entire expectations-gap table's premise, that West in twelve months looks like West today plus GLP-1 volume growth, stale regardless of which way GLP-1 demand itself went.

A GLP-1 self-injection device market still in its early volume-ramp years is a structural setup where a supplier's growth can plausibly outrun a diversified components company's own trailing multi-year average for longer than five years, which is precisely the base-rate question this dive's own percentile scoring (65 for revenue CAGR) already flags as sitting toward the upper, not the extreme, end of defensible outcomes.

explainer.verdict_line: אנחנו לא קונים, והפעם גם לא מחכים שהמחיר ירד קצת. המניה רצה הרבה יותר מהר מהרווחים של החברה, ולכן אנחנו חושבים שהזמן הטוב להיכנס כבר עבר.
explainer.what_they_do: וסט היא חברה אמריקאית שמייצרת את החלקים הקטנים והחשובים שבתוך בקבוקוני תרופה ומזרקים, כמו הפקקים מגומי, וגם מכשירים שעוזרים לאנשים להזריק לעצמם תרופה בבית, למשל לטיפול בסוכרת ובהשמנה.
explainer.why_now: בחודשים האחרונים החברה דיווחה שוב על דוחות חזקים והעלתה את התחזית שלה בפעם השלישית השנה, והמניה עלתה מאוד. אבל חלק גדול מהעלייה הגיע מזה שהמשקיעים הסכימו לשלם הרבה יותר על כל שקל של רווח, ופחות מזה שהרווחים עצמם גדלו.
explainer.why_market_misses: השוק לא מפספס כאן משהו נסתר, כי הרבה אנליסטים וקרנות גדולות כבר מחזיקים במניה. המחיר דורש שהכסף שנכנס לקופה יגדל הרבה יותר מהר ממה שאנחנו מצליחים להצדיק, והגידול העיקרי בא מחלק אחר של החברה, לא מהמכשירים להזרקה שבדקנו. ועוד דבר: החברה הרוויחה יותר על הנייר, אבל המזומן בקופה גדל פחות, וחלק מהלקוחות משלמים לאט יותר.
explainer.what_could_break: אם הגידול יאט, אם לקוחות ימשיכו לשלם באיחור, או אם תרופות בגלולה ידחקו את ההזרקות, המחיר יכול לרדת הרבה. גם מנכל חדש ומנהל כספים חדש בתוך זמן קצר הם סימן שכדאי לשים אליו לב.
explainer.what_would_change_our_mind: אם המחיר ירד הרבה, או אם בדוח השנתי הבא יתברר שהמזומן בקופה גדל באמת בקצב של הרווחים והלקוחות חזרו לשלם בזמן, נבדוק את המניה מחדש.

pre_mortem.premise: It is 2027-11-19, twelve months after this dive, and TOO_LATE was wrong: from $396.69 the stock outperformed SPY over the window and the funnel's 'no' was a missed continuation.
reasons: Cash caught up. The receivables build was timing (large customers paying later in the quarter or on longer terms), it unwound, FY2026 free cash flow printed at or above $600M or at least $540M with year-end DSO back under 70 days, capex held at $215M to $220M and the FY2027 guide came at 10% organic growth and a 25% margin, so the base the market compounds from grew and the nine-month cash shortfall was an accounting-calendar effect (watch_triggers[0], [1], [3]).

The multiple expansion was mostly a calendar artifact and the convention was wrong. On a next-twelve-months basis the share of the move that is multiple is 40% to 55% at 10% to 20% FY2027 EPS growth, a net-cash S&P 500 compounder with three guide raises and a falling share count (72.0M to 69.8M) held 35x to 40x, and at a discount rate near 7.5% the file's own stretch case ($414.6 over ten years) was the right case, so the file's base (8.0% revenue, 24% margin, both raised in this refresh and both SPECULATIVE) was too low.

A thing the file does not model: GLP-1 injectable volume or West's content per device grew far beyond the fivefold the capture arithmetic allows for, or the new CEO (effective 2026-08-31) deployed the balance sheet (net cash $261.2M after $685.3M of buybacks in nine months) into accretive buybacks or M&A that lifted per-share compounding above any FCF CAGR the file built, or a takeover premium arrived for a $28.6B name.
pre_mortem.why_the_market_could_have_been_right: Reason one is the most concrete and is exactly the file's own falsifier: the cash statement is the only leg of the case against the stock that shows a deterioration in the numbers, the guide has been raised three times, and the independence test's market-error category (recency and extrapolation) is also what a correct market call looks like before the cash arrives. Reason two is the second most concrete, because the verdict leans on the file's own base case being a better estimate than its stretch case and the convention stress shows the stretch case clears price at ten years under a lower discount rate. Both are answerable and tied to dated triggers, so the pre-mortem is answered and does not force a downgrade.
